d:
In this ground report by Khabargaon, we travelled to Gayaji in Bihar. We went to the Vishnupad temple situated on the banks of river Falgu and spoke to the pilgrims and localites. Just near the ghat, there is a masaan, where the people belonging to the Dom community highlighted casteism in the state.
We also spoke to the Muslim community about the town and the ongoing elections. Watch this report from the historical city of Gaya where various religions and cultures co-exist.
Report: Satyam Tiwari
Camera: Abhishek
Video Edit: Aakash
